scientific_integrity: The proof identifies scheme coordinate rings and uses exact algebraic identities; finite-field brute force corroborates only bounded instances. No independent mathematical audit has taken place.
scientific_limitations: Only operators diagonal in the natural basis of the rank-at-least-three cyclic evolution algebra are classified. No assertion about non-diagonal Rota–Baxter operators; weight-zero scheme structure is not determined. Priorities relative to alternative operator-theoretic presentations require external examination.
title: Arithmetic and infinitesimal strata of diagonal Rota–Baxter operators on cyclic evolution algebras
